lines.text: The word of the LORD came to Hosea son of Beeri, who was told to take a prostitute as his wife.
Hosea married Gomer daughter of Diblaim, and the LORD told him to name their son Jezreel.
The LORD said He would bring the bloodshed of Jezreel upon the house of Saul and break Israel's bow in the Valley of Jezreel.
Gomer bore a daughter named Lo-ruhamah, and the LORD said He would save Judah by horses and cavalry.
After Gomer weaned Lo-ruhamah, she bore another son, and the LORD told Hosea to name him Lo-ammi.
